title: Carried-Over and Agent-Native Threats in the Supply Chain of LLM Agent Skills
abstract: arXiv:2611.30932v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Agent skills are reusable packages that extend a large language model (LLM) agent with scripts, third-party dependencies, and natural-language instructions. An agent builds a skill's arguments from user requests and untrusted external content, so a flaw left by a benign author can escalate a prompt injection to code execution. Existing studies target malicious skills or a single attack vector, and none tests whether an agent can reach such flaws. We present the first registry-scale empirical study of the supply chain attack surface arising from unintentional vulnerabilities in agent skills, over all 48,682 skills in ClawHub. The study covers two carried-over risks, dependencies and first-party code, and two agent-native ones, install instructions and credentials printed to stdout. We screen all skills by static analysis, manually review all 3,428 cases flagged by the four main detectors, and test reachability by running sampled flagged

translated_title: LLM 智能体技能供应链中的遗留型与智能体原生威胁
translated_abstract: 智能体技能是通过脚本、第三方依赖和自然语言指令来扩展大语言模型（LLM）智能体能力的可复用软件包。智能体会根据用户请求和不受信任的外部内容来构建技能参数，因此善意作者遗留的缺陷可能将提示注入升级为代码执行。现有研究大多针对恶意技能或单一攻击向量，且没有研究测试智能体是否能够实际触达此类缺陷。我们针对智能体技能中非故意漏洞所引发的供应链攻击面，开展了首个注册表规模的实证研究，覆盖 ClawHub 上的全部 48,682 个技能。该研究涵盖两类遗留风险——依赖项与第一方代码，以及两类智能体原生风险——安装指令与打印到标准输出的凭证。我们通过静态分析筛查所有技能，人工审查四个主要检测器标记的全部 3,428 个案例，并通过运行抽样的被标记技能来测试可达性（摘要在此处截断）。
tldr: 该论文首次在注册表规模上对 LLM 智能体技能供应链中由非故意漏洞引发的攻击面进行实证研究，对 ClawHub 全部 48,682 个技能开展静态分析、人工审查（3,428 个标记案例）与可达性测试，覆盖依赖项和第一方代码两类遗留风险，以及安装指令和凭证泄露两类智能体原生风险。
en_tdlr: The paper presents the first registry-scale empirical study of the supply chain attack surface arising from unintentional vulnerabilities in LLM agent skills, screening all 48,682 ClawHub skills via static analysis, manually reviewing 3,428 flagged cases, and testing reachability across two carried-over risks (dependencies and first-party code) and two agent-native risks (install instructions and credentials printed to stdout).
